statement: The universal endpoint image criterion is equivalent to standard D; for a fixed target it is equivalent to D and vanishing of its Griffiths kernel, over any algebraically closed field with a fixed Weil cohomology
depends_on: Jannsen1992 Theorem1 pp448-449; Poincare duality; endpoint numerical=algebraic with Q coefficients; C.1k
notes: Exact equivalences, not proofs of D. Rational cycle coefficients, characteristic-zero Weil-cohomology coefficient field. Necessity uses an arbitrary numerically trivial source cycle as a functional. Sufficiency uses whole numerical motives and faithful graded realization under D on all products; no algebraic Kunneth projectors are assumed. Interior universal target codimensions are refuted over C by C.1k, with no positive-characteristic transfer claimed.
